## What happened

This notice records the change identified by reference CHG-0158. The change was titled "Letter bureau platform migration" and began on 2023-06-05. The change was completed on 2023-09-25.

The change concerned the migration of the platform used by the letter bureau. This notice provides a record of the period covered and the service impact associated with the change.

## Cause

The cause recorded for the change was: Supplier moved print platform. The migration was undertaken by the supplier and affected the platform supporting letter production and dispatch.

## Effect

The recorded effect was: Dispatch slowed for months. This resulted in a prolonged reduction in dispatch speed during the period covered by the notice. Staff should use reference CHG-0158 when raising questions about this change with the service desk.
